scope: Limited synthetic cross-node Git/storage feasibility and observed service health. Not device/MQTT latency tails, real agents, platform fencing, storage/node outage recovery or build acceptance.
launchGates: Owner Q21 accepted ADR002 and bounded trial
Root approves exact helper diff, rendered Jobs, isolated PVC diff and measured tripwires
Both PRs current required checks and actual advisory findings resolved
Freeze complete last30m baseline immediately before launch, adequate coverage, safe initial state, expected series known

resources.startupHeadroom: The peer barrier consumes the original 145s total helper budget; the clock is never reset. Combined startup/phase duration can abort the fixture even if each individual phase cap is met. Such a run is incomplete, not a storage pass or rejection. Startup timing is separate from the ordinary15s command measurements.

provenance.requiredBeforeLaunch: Job annotations exact source commit/SHA256; decoded main args exactly match merged helper source; signed image digest unchanged; actual admitted bounds/placement/mounts/token absence verified

finiteDiagnostics.trace2Lifecycle: reader remains open until bounded command owner terminates/reaps Git, discarding if private retention writes fail; after owner stop at most64KiB additional drain,0.5s join, early-return file close; truncation/unavailability explicit
cpuMeasurements: resolved own cgroup-v2 cpu.stat deltas and cpu.max; unavailable is explicit
finiteDiagnostics.gitBuildMetadata: one bounded git --version --build-options per role; does not prove USE_STDEV compile selection
indexStatPhases: postFileIO for own and peer tasks
finiteDiagnostics.indexStatSamplingOrder: after successful exact status, once per task/phase, native ls-files --debug and os.stat; no warmup or failure retry
phaseReceipts: build-done copy/archive duration and bulk-file-write quiescence
finiteDiagnostics.bounds: original command/global/Job/resource/data caps; no Git configuration, change-detection, WIP, storage or launch-order change

instantAbort: critical Ready<1, UID change, or restart increase>0
missing expected metric series or insufficient freshness/coverage
observability.lokiMQTTDisconnectCounter: sum(count_over_time({app="zigbee2mqtt"} |~ "(?i)not connected to mqtt server"[2m])) or vector(0)
